objects: All existing repository files and prior seat-card-packaging-v1 blend scenes

design_intent.thesis: Rounded expressive head turns toward participants; a substantial stationary pebble base carries electronics and independent yaw support
design_intent.reference_policy: NOMI is general proportion inspiration only, no image reconstruction and no copy of branding; Image2 hero is not a CAD dimensional source

visual_flow: eyes lead to speaker direction while fixed plinth remains grounded
camera_mobility: free inspection, fixed review cameras, bounded yaw poses

representation_budget.native_geometry: head/base shells, true cavities, neck bore
representation_budget.proxy: board/servo/bearing/camera, port locations, no final mechanisms

failure_repair_policy: repair only failed packaging region; preserve prior v1 and concept image

minimum_analysis.deliverable: editable new .blend with dimension-driven rounded silhouette and stationary base hardware; image2 is separate concept
minimum_analysis.protected_scope: all pre-existing files and scene objects
minimum_analysis.scale: mm, external anchors main PCB 115x80 / LCD PCB79.4x58.4
uncertainty: actual PCB populated heights and ports
LCD and camera connectors/pin mapping and acceptable flex length
FPC cable routing and bend radius over yaw stroke
SG90 gear backlash, idle acoustic noise, firmware pins, inertia and loaded torque
bearing SKU / motor mount / transmission ratio / head receiver / hard stop
speaker acoustic chamber and fixed mic acoustic ports
thermal, tipping stability, print tolerances and fasteners
